name: mafia-lan
description: LAN Mafia — Offline Multiplayer Mafia Game

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:android: node scripts/bundle-android-server.mjs && (cd android && export JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21 && ./gradlew assembleDebug) && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ./mafia-server.apk
